description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering attendance reports in the OrangeHRM time management plugin. It extends date range filtering capabilities and includes properties for employee numbers, job title ID, sub-unit ID, and employment status ID, along with their getter and setter methods.

classes.name: AttendanceReportSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO for specifying filters when generating attendance reports, including date ranges, employee numbers, job title, subnet, and employment status.

methods.name: getJobTitleId
methods.description: Retrieves the job title ID filter value.

methods.name: setJobTitleId
methods.description: Sets the job title ID filter value.

methods.name: getSubUnitId
methods.description: Retrieves the sub-unit ID filter value.

methods.name: setSubUnitId
methods.description: Sets the sub-unit ID filter value.

methods.name: getEmploymentStatusId
methods.description: Retrieves the employment status ID filter value.

methods.name: setEmploymentStatusId
methods.description: Sets the employment status ID filter value.

methods.name: getEmployeeNumbers
methods.description: Retrieves the list of employee numbers for filtering.

methods.name: setEmployeeNumbers
methods.description: Sets the list of employee numbers for filtering.
